ov: فيلم أُصدر سنة 1993، من إخراج سيدني بولاك
plotEn:
Mitch McDeere, a top Harvard Law School graduate, accepts a lucrative offer from Bendini, Lambert & Locke, a small boutique law firm of forty-one lawyers in Memphis, Tennessee that also takes a great interest in the notions of family. After relocating to Memphis with his wife Abby, a schoolteacher, Mitch prepares for the bar exam. Senior partner Avery Tolar mentors Mitch on the firm's strict culture of loyalty, confidentiality, and high fees. In addition to the high-figure salary and guaranteed increase after the first year of employment, the firm's benefits include a new house with a low interest-rate mortgage, a new Mercedes-Benz complete with choice of color, and paid-off student loans; Mitch, who managed to work his way up from a poor family, is dazzled by his apparent good fortune, but Abby, who has had a more privileged background, resents the firm's meddling in employees' personal lives. On the day of a social visit to the house of Mitch's friend and colleague Lamar Quinn, the McDeeres are tearfully informed by Lamar's wife Kay that two of the firm's associates have been killed in an explosion whilst scuba-diving during a work trip to the Cayman Islands; during the drive home, Abby voices her belief that Kay seemed "scared".
